name: Take Charge
summary: Choose a skill the kingdom is at least trained in and make a basic check; success gains 1 RP. The same skill cannot be used twice in the same kingdom turn.

name: Request Foreign Aid
summary: Ask a faction with diplomatic relations for aid. DC starts at the faction's Negotiation DC +2, rises +2 per repeat request, falls -1 per turn unused; once per group per turn.

name: Capital Investment
summary: Invest in the kingdom's future. House rule: allowed in the Capital, or within the influence of a settlement with at least one Bank.

name: Claim Hex
summary: Claim an unclaimed hex adjacent to the kingdom; gain XP by kingdom size (see Reference). From level 9: 3 times per turn (house rule).

name: Build Roads
summary: Build a road connecting two adjacent claimed hexes.

name: Establish Work Site
summary: Establish a work site (farmland, lumber camp, mine, quarry) on a hex with the matching resource.

name: Reconnoiter Hex
summary: Spend 1 RP and make a basic check to survey a hex; success marks it reconnoitered for Claim Hex and may reveal features.

name: Build Settlement
summary: Build a new settlement in a claimed hex.

name: Abandon Settlement
summary: Abandon a settlement, freeing its hex.

name: Build Structure
summary: Build a structure on empty lots in a settlement.

name: Upgrade Structure
summary: Upgrade a structure to the next level.

name: Repair Structure
summary: Repair a damaged or destroyed structure.

name: Demolish Structure
summary: Demolish a structure, freeing its lots.

name: Expand Settlement
summary: Expand a settlement's size (more blocks and lots).

name: Recruit Army
summary: Recruit a new army or add units to an existing one.

name: Train Army
summary: Train an army to improve its statistics.

name: Move Army
summary: Move an army to a new location.

name: Army Battle
summary: Use an army in battle or to defend a border.
